notes.title: The Future of Pilgrim Adventures
notes.notes:
With the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1020590/Space_Pilgrim_Academy_Reunion/]Space Pilgrim Academy: Reunion[/url] last weekend, I wanted to give all of you folks an update on what's happening with this series and the future of Pilgrim Adventures in general.

Although Reunion is the concluding chapter of what can be referred to as the [i]Latona[/i] story arc, focusing on Maggie's search for her mother, you'll probably get the sense that there's still more story left to tell.

There's been some discussion and speculation on the forums about how many years there are at the Pilgrim Space Academy, and the answer is that there are [b]six[/b]. This means Maggie and her fellow cadets are only halfway through their time at the academy. So, the intention is to create a second story arc which would cover years 4 through 6 and possibly beyond.

However ... this won't happen immediately.

I've been almost exclusively working on the Academy games for nearly two years now, and during that time I've had ideas for various other interesting projects which have had to remain on the shelf. The first of these is already in development and should be arriving relatively soon.

Also, the opportunity for the first collaboration between Pilgrim Adventures and another game developer has recently presented itself, which is very exciting!

So, the plan is to take a some time to work on these other projects, and then to return to the Academy series at some point in the future.

Before making any further Academy adventures, I would also like to do a major update to the existing games in the series with enhanced graphics, more varied facial expressions for the lead characters, and some improvements to gameplay.

Obviously the success and popularity of the Academy series will affect the decision of when to start work on the new chapters, so if you'd like to expedite their arrival, the best thing you could do would be to leave Steam reviews on the previous games if you haven't already - particularly [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/694370/Space_Pilgrim_Academy_Year_1/]Year 1[/url]. You could also help out by recommending the series to your friends, foes, followers, dependants, colleagues and minions. It would be very much appreciated!

Finally, I'd also like to mention that in addition to the Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33753618]developer page[/url], we've also newly created accounts on [url=https://twitter.com/PilgrimGameDev]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/PilgrimGameDev/]Facebook[/url] to make it easier for you to follow what's going on! The [url=http://www.pilgrimadventures.com/]website[/url] is also being updated.

notes.title: Performance Update (1.4)
notes.notes:
Please note that the location of save files has changed. If your previous save files aren't appearing in-game, do the following:
[list]
[*] Go to the game folder (usually something like 
[b]\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\Crown Champion Legends of the Arena[/b]).
[*] Move the existing 'save' folder into the 'www' folder.
[*] Your saves should now appear in the game.
[/list]
This update is mainly geared towards improving overall performance, particularly for those players who had been experiencing sudden crashes. The game engine has been updated to the latest version, and a couple of minor bugs have been fixed.

Please let us know if you experience any problems after the update.

notes.title: Third Update (1.3)
notes.notes:
This latest update features a lot of tweaks to skills and enemy stats, with the aim of making things more fairly balanced. If you're continuing a save from a previous version, you will probably experience a period of adjustment. Version 1.2 is still available under 'Betas' if you'd prefer to keep playing with the same difficulty level.

[list][*] The resolution has been increased to 1280x720, which means some exterior scenes have been expanded in size.
[*] [b]New content:[/b] There are now about a dozen events related to the management of your estate that can occur randomly between tournaments. These can be positive events such as receiving visits from sponsors or fans, or your slaves having a particularly good week in training. There can also be negative events such as slaves falling ill or getting in trouble with the guards.
[*] There are also some individual one-off events that can crop up, which are like mini adventures. Most of these short stories can also have positive or negative outcomes depending on your actions.
[*] Some AI improvements to player-owned fighters. They should no longer perform skills that increase Attack, Defense, Reflexes or Agility if those effects are already at maximum.
[/list]

notes.title: Second Update (1.2)
notes.notes:
[h1]Technical Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game crashed at achievement points if it had not been launched through your Steam library.
[*] You can now use the [b]Page Down[/b] key to fast-forward through dialogue until the next choice appears.
[*] Pressing the cancel button on your controller during choice menus should generally default to the appropriate cancel option if one is available.
[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] The environments are more interactive. You can now examine or interact with most objects in the game. (Be sure to try interacting with the wardrobe in your bedroom!) 
[*] Whether or not a fighter feels like talking to you is now determined at the start of the week. Fighters will always want to talk to you on their first week in your cells.
[*] The Royal Academy trainer has been moved closer to the market entrance to save unnecessary walking. 
[*] When you build the guard tower, you now get a guard posted outside the treasury each week. 
[*] A little bit more has been added to the ending of the game. It's not 100% compatible with current saves, but it will add a little something extra when you win at the royal tournament for the first time.
[/list]

[h1]Combat-Related[/h1]
[list]
[*] Special skills now unlock at a slightly earlier level than before, so your fighters won't lag quite as far behind their enemies in terms of the skills they can use. If you are using a save from an earlier version of the game, the appropriate skills should unlock when you progress to the next week.
[*] Enemy Foxes can no longer dual wield if they also use throwing stars.
[*] The amount of damage done by critical attacks has been reduced.
[*] A few other small balance tweaks to various skills. 
[/list]

We're still looking at ways to improve performance and stability for those players who have been experiencing poor performance or random crashes. Keep an eye out for further updates.
